name: ALPHA, Plaintiff-Appellant, v. BETA CORP., Defendant-Appellee

court.name: United States Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit

opinions.author: Judge X
opinions.text:
Alpha sued under Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964, 42 U.S.C. § 2000e-3(a), alleging retaliation.

We hold that an adverse employment action means an ultimate employment decision.

Affirmed.
